find.description: Find issues of the bound Jira project by text, semantic state and labels, in key order, one bounded page at a time, with JQL the provider builds; caller text never adds a clause. States map to status categories: To Do is open, In Progress is in_progress, Done is done, and Done resolved Won't Do or Duplicate is canceled. Jira's search index trails recent writes by seconds; blocked matches nothing.

get.description: Read one issue of the bound Jira site by its numeric id. providerState is the status name.

create.description: Open an issue of settings.issueType (Task unless set) in the bound Jira project. The idempotency key is recorded as a hidden label and the request digest as an issue property: a repeated key returns the issue it opened, even before Jira's search shows it, the same key with other content is a conflict, and a create whose outcome is unknown is read back and answered unresolved rather than opened twice. Only an issue the credential's account opened answers for a key; two concurrent calls with one key are not detected.

update.description: Change an issue's summary, description or labels. Labels replace the task's labels; the hidden idempotency label stays. expectedRevision is compared with the issue read just before the write: Jira has no conditional issue write, so a writer between the two is not detected.

transition.description: Move an issue to a semantic state through the first workflow transition Jira offers into the target status category; canceled also sets the resolution Won't Do. blocked, and a state the workflow offers no transition into, are unsupported. expectedRevision is compared with the issue read just before the write.
